cohort: 9,561 women who delivered at Montefiore Medical Center between January 2015 and June 2016
finding: Women who received immediate postpartum IUDs and implants had lower rates of short interpregnancy interval pregnancies compared to patients who did not receive immediate postpartum LARC.
mod_finding: Women who received immediate postpartum IUDs and implants had lower rates of short interpregnancy interval delivery and pregnancy compared to patients who did not receive immediate postpartum LARC.
